rows.role_title: State President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: Proclamation No. 98, 1994, amending Schedule 2 to the Public Service Act, 1984 with effect from 10 May 1994 to add the Office of the Deputy Executive President from the Largest Minority Party, was given at Cape Town on 9 May 1994 and signed by F. W. de Klerk as State President, by order of the State President-in-Cabinet (countersigned R. F. Botha).
